infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Choose screenshots of schedules, syllabi or messages to turn into calendar events.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Take a photo of a schedule or flyer to turn it into calendar events.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Tempo uses your location to learn where you study, work out and spend time, so it can suggest study sessions that fit your real routine.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow "Always" so Tempo can learn your routine in the background (e.g. library on Tuesday afternoons, gym on Monday evenings). Location is only sent to your own Tempo server.
